 In the midst of CBS’s 2026-2027 TV cycle, an important change is coming to the Fire Country franchise that will impact both Sheriff Country and its parent series. Sheriff Country reaching its second season with great success proved that the crime drama has already affirmed itself as a separate entity from Fire Country . This made so many more crossovers possible between Sheriff Country and Fire Country beyond the big crossover event of November 6, making the overlapping storylines between the two CBS shows feel especially seamless.

 The greater connection between Sheriff Country season 2 and Fire Country season 5 was also reflected by their runs going in tandem, with no episode of the firefighting drama being unaccompanied by the police procedural and vice versa. It won’t be like that for the rest of the 2026-2027 TV cycle, as Fire Country season 5’s smaller number of episodes than both its previous seasons and Sheriff Country season 2 was announced earlier in 2016, forcing the CBS crime drama to continue without it.
 Sheriff Country ’s strong link to its parent series will nevertheless go on for a couple more months, as both CBS shows will follow the same schedule until Fire Country season 5 ’s finale on Friday, February 5, 2027. Unfortunately, the connection is also reflected in the first hiatus of the TV cycle for Sheriff Country season 2 and Fire Country season 5, forcing both shows not to return for some time.
 Fire & Sheriff Country Are Going On Their First Midseason Break Of 2026
 CBS 
 Sheriff Country season 2 and Fire Country season 5 won’t return with new episodes this week. The two CBS dramas aired their sixth respective episodes on November 13, 2026, and will return with new ones on December 11, 2026. With a break of four weeks, this will be the longest hiatus among those already scheduled, and the longest one overall for Fire Country season 5, based on the knowledge that the season finale is happening in early February.
 This break will not be the last one this winter. Fire Country season 5 and Sheriff Country season 2 will air their midseason finales on December 18, 2026. This hiatus thus gives both shows time to set up the most shock-inducing storylines for their winter finales, and it’s clear from the trailers of Sheriff Country season 2, episode 7 and Fire Country season 5, episode 7 that the first will lean on Mickey and Boone’s trust issues and the return of Cassidy’s ex, while the second will focus on Station 42’s data center infighting and the consequences of Sharon’s theft.
 Why Fire & Sheriff Country's Mini-Breaks In The Middle Of The Season Are Important
 MovieStillsDB 
 The reason for this break in particular in CBS’s 2026-2027 TV cycle and its length has not been specified. However, network TV shows usually go on hiatus several times throughout the season, with the most common reasons for a break being the network taking advantage of the so-called sweeps weeks, when new ad rates for the rest of the year are determined, or special programming happening instead, for example, as a result of a holiday.
 Thanksgiving happening on Thursday, November 26, 2026, wholly justifies Sheriff Country season 2 and Fire Country season 5’s hiatus. The length of the break might instead have to do with network TV’s defined structure, with midseason finales usually airing near the holiday season. With only two episodes remaining before a break in regular programming for the end-of-year holiday season, such a hiatus makes sense so that the Fire Country franchise’s winter finales will both air on December 18.

 While no new episodes will air on Friday, November 20, a rerun of Sheriff Country season 2’s premiere will air at 10 pm ET, following the Kentucky vs. Indiana College Basketball game at 8 pm. Although it’s not the same as new episodes, this means that something part of the Fire Country franchise will still air on the day.
